speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of binucleated cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm in your urine is highly suggestive of Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN), often caused by a drug hypersensitivity to the antibiotics you recently took. Have you noticed any new skin rash, itching, or joint pain since starting those medications? REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity. The presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells in your urine, combined with fever, flank pain, and recent antibiotic use, confirms this diagnosis even in the absence of a skin rash.
